depiction_rules.notes: Provisional D036 scene-continuity contract for comparison generation, not an approved character sheet or art approval.

visual_bible.continuity_markers: One recurring adult ascetic-warrior with long dark hair, beard, simple tied hair, sacred thread, muted ochre wrap, and ordinary two-arm/two-leg anatomy throughout. One coherent axe; bow, quiver and chariot only where called for.

never: No additional arms, changing face or age, bodybuilder anatomy, bloodied weapon, gore, crown, cloned body, or detached prop.
note: Provisional D036 contract from canonical verses, mapped intake photographs, and the matte series rules. No character sheet or stanza artwork is approved.
